ruleDefinitions.name: CodeIntegrity - Unmet WHQL Requirements For Loaded Kernel Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects loaded kernel modules that did not meet the WHQL signing requirements. Note: Unmapped fields: FileNameBuffer

sequences.query: (event_id = 3082 OR event_id = 3083) AND  NOT ((FileNameBuffer = "system32\\drivers\\vsock\.sys" OR FileNameBuffer = "System32\\drivers\\vmci\.sys"))
